# Code of conduct

SPREAD follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

We want SPREAD to be a welcoming project for everyone who uses it or contributes to it, whatever their background or experience. Be respectful and constructive in issues, pull requests and any other space of the project; harassment and personal attacks are not accepted.

Report unacceptable behaviour to the maintainers at **bioinformatica@izs.it**. Every report is reviewed and kept confidential; the maintainers apply the enforcement guidelines of the Contributor Covenant.
